officialSource.nativeIdentity: OBJECTID (ArcGIS OID), retained as source-scoped objectid:10622118
officialSource.fieldMapping: retained properties.id = objectid:<OBJECTID>; no source attributes retained in GeoJSON
officialSource.compositeKeyProvenance: The layer also publishes setor/quadra/face/lote and related lote_* fields, but the sample uses the stable ArcGIS OBJECTID only; no composite key was constructed.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.observation: Official GeoItajaí landing page; describes cadastral map and municipal geospatial applications.
Official cadastral viewer page; current HTML inspected and its public ArcGIS-backed viewer route followed.
Layer metadata returned polygon type, EPSG:4674, city-scale extent, fields and query capability.
Bounded anonymous 500 m query around exact WUP point returned one polygon, OBJECTID 10622118, GeoJSON geometry in EPSG:4326. Returned source attributes were not retained.
Unbounded countless-field smoke request succeeded; no geometry or unsafe attributes requested.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: The published municipal cadastral layer extent covers Itajaí municipality-scale coordinates; the service metadata does not itself prove every parcel is populated.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: City-scale layer extent and one valid polygon within 500 m of the WUP point; broader completeness not independently measured.

remainingUncertainty: The WUP coordinate is a research locator, not a claim that the exact point lies inside the returned polygon; the returned polygon is within the requested 500 m radius. Municipal layer completeness, update cadence and legal cadastral status require separate review.
nextStep: Serial reviewer should independently re-query the official service, confirm city coverage and native OBJECTID semantics, and decide adapter qualification.
